## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 发布时可以写一句变更说明,它会写进这次发布的每一条元数据历史;历史面板显示操作者的名字(查不到时显示 id 并标注"未解析的用户"),说明显示在该行下面。
- 为什么改:历史里只有一串用户 id 和一句固定的 `publish app package 'PACKAGE_ID'`,管理员挑版本回滚时看不出是谁、为什么改的;另外发布门把请求体里的 `actor` 当作操作者,持有 `manage_metadata` 的人可以冒名。
- 风险与回滚:发布门现在只认会话身份,请求体 `actor` 被忽略;不写说明时行为与之前一致。回滚即还原本 PR,没有数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`(publish-drafts 门取会话身份、转发 message)、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`(每项 promote 的 change_note)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/historyActors.ts`(姓名解析)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts`,预期 4 个用例全绿(真实 SQLite 里每条历史行带说明、记录会话用户)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Runtime door (`POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` only).** The door forwards a string `message` from the body, and records the actor as the user id of the request's authorized execution context (`resolvePackageWriteActor`, the rule `RestServer.resolveMetaWriteActor` holds for the `/meta` write doors). A body `actor` is ignored; a context with no user id records no actor. The six sibling package doors are untouched (carried by #28414).

**Protocol.** `publishPackageDrafts` passes `request.message` to each `promoteDraftForPublish` in place of the hard-coded `publish app package 'PACKAGE_ID'`, so every `sys_metadata_history` row the batch writes stores it as `change_note`. The package commit already kept it. No note, or an empty one, keeps today's sentence.

**SDK.** `packages.publishDrafts(id, opts)` gains `opts.message`. `opts.actor` stays in the type, marked `@deprecated` (the door ignores it), so no caller breaks.

**Console.**
- `MetadataClient.publishPackageDrafts` picks `message` beside `backfill` and sends it only when given (no options still sends `{}`).
- The publish review (`DraftChangesPanel` footer) offers an optional change note where it publishes one package as a batch (`onPublish && packageId`, the same condition as the backfill choice). Sent trimmed; an empty note sends nothing, and a sheet with neither a note nor a backfill choice still calls its host with no options. `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` is not edited: its `doPublish(options)` already hands the sheet's options to `publishPackageDrafts(packageId, options)`.
- `HistoryPanel` shows each actor by name, read from `sys_user` once per set of ids (`historyActors.ts`). An id with no row (a deleted user), a failed or refused directory read, or no adapter shows the id marked "unresolved user". A `null` actor shows none. The event's `message` is shown under the row; `HistoryEvent` gains `message`.
- Strings: `engine.edit.historyBy` / `historyActorUnresolved` / `historyActorUnresolvedHint` in the studio namespace (en, zh); `preview.changes.noteLabel` / `notePlaceholder` in all ten locale packs.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-64y985`, not `claude/issue-28406-*`; the card is #28406.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts` (new, real ObjectQL + SqlDriver over better-sqlite3, through `HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`): a note reaches every history row and the commit, and `historyMetaItem` reads it back as `message` with the session user as `actor`; no note keeps the sentence; a body `actor` is ignored and the session user is recorded on every row and the commit; a system context records no actor.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.changeNote.test.tsx` (new): the field is offered only on the batch door with a Publish, disabled while publishing; a note is sent trimmed as `{ message }`; empty or whitespace sends no options; the note rides beside a checked backfill choice.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/item-tools/ResourceHistoryPage.actorAndNote.test.tsx` (new): name shown with the id on its title and one directory read for the distinct ids; a missing row and a failed read show the id marked unresolved; a `null` actor shows none; notes under rows.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.publishMessage.test.ts` (new): the body bytes with and without a note.
- Moved pin: `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-seed-apply-org-scope.test.ts` asserted the exact protocol request `{ packageId, context }`; it now carries `actor: the caller's userId`, the change this PR makes.

## Acceptance notes

- `message` follows the single-item publish door's rule: a string is forwarded, any other type sends no note (no 400). Item 4's request schema is where a stricter shape would be declared.
- The unresolved marker does not say "deleted": a missing row and a refused directory read look the same from the console, and naming the wrong one would be a made-up fact on an audit surface. The hint text names both causes.
- The claim's `Metadata-protocol: yes` is outside the closed vocabulary the changeset gate reads (`added | narrowed | semantic | none`). Nothing a metadata author writes changes here (a REST body key, a history note, the console), so this PR declares `none`, and the changeset is `patch`.
- The claim named `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/{en,zh}.ts`; the publish-review keys live in the locale packs, which `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds to every `en` key, so all ten packs carry them. The history panel's keys live in the studio namespace, which is en + zh by design.
- `usePublishAllDrafts.ts` (Home banner, draft-preview bar) is unchanged: neither surface has a review step with a note, and a parameter no caller passes would be declared but never written.
